dedupe_keys.name: chronology of major tailings dam failures

description: The Chronology of major tailings dam failures is a table maintained by the WISE Uranium Project, a non-governmental information service on uranium mining, listing tailings dam failures worldwide from 1960 to the present; it was last updated on 20 August 2026. For each event it gives date, location, parent company, ore type, type of incident, volume released and impacts, such as the August 2026 collapse at the Dikwena chrome mine in South Africa that cut mine access and Eskom power lines, or the 2025 failures in Indonesia, Zambia, the DR Congo and Bolivia. The table is a single HTML page, free to read, with links to press and official reports for each event. No licence is stated. Caveats: the provider notes that the compilation is in no way complete because of limited data, released volumes are often unknown, and entries rely on news reports, not an official register. For simulation it is an event record for calibrating dam-breach likelihood, post-event analysis and cascading impacts of tailings failures on downstream roads, power lines, water and settlements. Related catalogue records include the Global Tailings Portal, which lists facilities, and the USGS Mineral Resources Data System.
